hooks.command: f=$(node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",(d)=>(s+=d)).on("end",()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(s).tool_input.file_path||"")}catch{}})'); case "$f" in *src/styles/*|*.astro|*src/components/*) r=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || r="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -f "$r/scripts/check-style.mjs" ] || exit 0; out=$(node "$r/scripts/check-style.mjs" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
